verdict.rationale: Featurebase offers generic integrations and webhooks that could theoretically push approved items into delivery tools, but there is no evidence of a specific 'approved spec' object or a documented workflow for pulling an approved specification into a dev/delivery pipeline (e.g., Jira/Linear ticket creation with spec content). missing for 10: explicit approved-spec status/workflow, named delivery-tool integration (Jira/Linear/GitHub) for spec handoff, and confirmation that spec content transfers into implementation tasks.
